content:
Hello everyone!

My name is Filippo Belfiori. I am a Ph.D. student at first year in mathematics in Paris. I am mainly intersted in Algebra and Algebraic Geometry. During the last months I have been studying Lean 4 (basically through the online games and I read the book Mathematics in Lean). I am very interested in continuing practising using Lean 4. However, I struggle in using in it for more advanced mathematics, expecially in Algebraic Geometry. I want to say that I am a very beginner, but I am extremely curious and would love to deepen my understanding.

Since I am new to this, any advice is greatly appreciated. I am not entirely sure what the best way is to start doing some Algebraic Geometry in Lean 4.

I would really like to formalize a few lemmas in commutative algebra to continue practising. For example, I am interested in writing some lemmas about the henselization of a ring with respect to an ideal. To begin, I would like to treat the case of a local ring, as in Lemma 04GG. Do you know if there is anything in Mathlib (or elsewhere) concerning henselian rings or the henselization of a ring, beyond what is already available in the library?

Thank you very much for your help, and I wish you all a wonderful day or evening!

It would be lovely to have a robust treatment of Henselian local rings but I don't know of any lean work in this area modulo what is in mathlib. There is probably a lot of low-hanging fruit here which I imagine would be very welcome in mathlib.
Great, thank you very much for your reply! I am happy to hear that, I will try to do it.
I think a good first target is 04GG. We probably have some of the characterizations in mathlib, but not all of them.
Ok nice. Thank you Riccardo for the suggestion and for the help!
